info.name: DataConnect — Connections & Templates (all types)
info.description:
Each connection type runs as a Create -> Test -> Discover trio. The Create request's test script saves the new id into a collection variable (conn_<type>_id), which the Test and Discover requests reuse. Run a whole folder top-to-bottom in the Collection Runner.

Adapter required fields (connection_adapters.py):
- Database adapter: connection_config needs hostname AND database; /discover reads tables.
- API adapter: needs base_url or url (http/https); optional health_path does a real GET; /discover reads endpoints.
- File adapter: needs bucket or path or container; /discover reads objects.

Gotcha: mongodb, elasticsearch, http, ftp are valid source_types but FALL BACK to the Database adapter, so their /test still requires hostname+database.

exec: if (id) { pm.collectionVariables.set('conn_ftp_id', id); console.log('saved conn_ftp_id=' + id); }
if (id) { pm.collectionVariables.set('conn_api_id', id); console.log('saved conn_api_id=' + id); }
if (id) { pm.collectionVariables.set('conn_s3_id', id); console.log('saved conn_s3_id=' + id); }
if (id) { pm.collectionVariables.set('conn_gcs_id', id); console.log('saved conn_gcs_id=' + id); }
